title: Brand Marketing Executive - 12 month FTC
description:
Think Specialist Recruitment are delighted to be working with a Global organisation based within the Watford area. This company are a market leader within their field, they have an exciting opportunity for a Degree educated candidate with 1-2 years experience, to join their Brand Marketing team. This position will be working closely with the Brand Marketing Managers, playing a key part in planning, delivering and executing brand plans for the business.
This person will need to have 1-2 years experience within Marketing, and due to the fact this company work within the office 4 days, this person will need to be local to the office.

Salary - 28,000 - 32,000 depending on experience
Monday - Friday 9am - 5pm - 4 days in and 1 day from home
Please note - this is an initial 12 month FTC
Some of the duties will include:
- Supporting annual brand plans and coordinating activity across multiple channels
- Helping lead SEO, eCRM and social activity, working with both internal teams and external agencies
- Developing and refining messaging across social, PR, SEO and campaign assets
- Supporting new product launches and working with Product, Trade and Digital teams on go-to-market plans
- Ensuring product and website content is accurate, engaging, optimised and focused on consumer benefits
- Briefing agencies, reviewing creative, coordinating feedback and keeping projects moving
- Ensuring communications consistently reflect brand positioning, tone of voice and visual identity
- Coordinating activity with internal and external partners to deliver a smooth customer experience
- Conducting brand, competitor, marketing and retail audits to identify trends, gaps and opportunities
- Supporting budgets, purchase orders, reporting and day-to-day project management

The suitable candidate:
- Degree Educated candidate
- 1-2 years experience within a marketing focused role
- Previous experience delivering marketing campaigns across multiple channels
- Strong communication skills on all levels both verbal and written
- Has the ability to multi-task and prioritise a busy workload
- Can build strong working relationships both internally and externally
- A good understanding of social media
- Must be local to Watford

Looking for the next step in your career? Think Specialist Recruitment.

Think Specialist Recruitment is an independent support staff recruitment agency based in Hemel Hempstead and working across the Herts, Beds and Bucks area. We specialise in permanent, temporary and contract recruitment with areas of expertise including: administration, customer service/call centre, PA/secretarial, human resources, accountancy and finance, sales admin/sales support, marketing and IT Helpdesk/IT support

title: Digital Marketing Executive - UX Specialist
description:
Digital Marketing Executive - UX Specialist

Permanent Full-time or Part-time (candidate dependant)

Salary £22,000 - £28,000 depending on experience

We are looking for a motivated digital marketing geek who loves data, insights, digging deep into why things are the way they are and then creating an amazing user experience.

About Relton Digital Marketing

"We Believe in Creating & Delivering Success" to our clients and ourselves. We are a Strategic Digital Marketing agency unlike no other. We care about our clients and we're extremely transparent in our bespoke reporting to them. Our clients are typically National and International and we're growing, so this is a new role.

We do not have your typical hierarchal structure in our office. We own our work and conduct ourselves in the most helpful and professional way at all times. We hold ourselves accountable, so the client doesn't need to. We are a small team of dedicated digital marketing specialists and would like to bring you into the fold. We all make the tea and coffees.

About You

You will be pro-active and passionate about everything you do and about doing the best job possible. That's you in the office and in your own pursuits. You will be inquisitive, self-motivated, a problem solver and have oodles of common sense. We do not intend for you to wait to be told what to do, but ask questions, actively seek answers and co-ordinate with the team. You communication skills are key.

This is a permanent full-time or a part-time role, we will be flexible for the right candidate. All training can be given, it's you we're interested in. However, some experience is preferred, a passion for digital is a must. While it's a UX role, it is built around sound data and then layered with human insight and a professional UX mindset. Pulling the data is important, but how you apply it is the 'magic'. This is predominantly an office-based role.

Main Duties
- Creating, improving and delivering our Competitor Analysis' reporting
- Preparing our bespoke SEO reporting
- Monitoring and reporting on AI Search results
- Creating and driving our clients' Content Strategies based on data, but built with the human psyche in mind
- Managing targeted Link Building for our clients
- Creating great articles that build internal links
- Use various tools to carry out your reports and contribute to UX strategy and SEO
- Uploading blog content and other content through various CMSs
- Manage Clients' Google Alerts
- Carry out META Data fixes for client websites

Other Duties
- Liaise directly with clients and making clear direct recommendations
- Build and send our own e-newsletters as well as for clients
- Using Canva to produce content when needed
- Stay updated with industry trends, Google algorithm changes, and best practices
- We want to hear about your other passions and skillsets that could support us and our clients that are not mentioned in this job description

Other areas
- Content creation
- We value your creative input on everything we do
- You will be expected to support the team wherever needed

What Relton Digital Marketing has for you

You will have the full support of our Digital Marketing Specialists and receive the training you need to excel not just in UX and SEO, but a wide variety of digital and traditional marketing channels.

You will receive:
- 20 days holiday plus Bank Holidays (25 days after 2 years)
- Private Medical Cover (after you pass your probation period)
- Opportunities to learn and grow within a smaller, supportive team of specialists
- SEO Training where needed

Your application

You must provide a covering letter; your application will not be reviewed otherwise. You must have the right to work in the UK (excluding a student visa)

title: Ecommerce Website Specialist
description:
At Altro, we're looking for an Ecommerce Website Specialist who will take ownership of our online store and help ensure customers have a smooth and engaging experience when shopping with us online.

You'll be responsible for keeping our website up to date, making sure products are displayed correctly, improving how customers find us online, and helping to generate more sales through digital marketing activity.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with Shopify experience who enjoys a varied role that combines website management, digital marketing, content creation and data analysis.

This is a permanent, hybrid role working 3 days a week in our Letchworth Garden City, Hertfordshire HQ.

So, what will I be doing?
- Managing and maintaining our Shopify ecommerce website.
- Adding new products and updating existing products, including descriptions, images, pricing and specifications.
- Setting up promotions, discounts and special offers.
- Making sure products are easy for customers to find and browse.
- Updating homepage banners, website content and seasonal campaigns.
- Monitoring website performance and identifying ways to improve the customer experience.
- Ensuring stock availability is accurately displayed online.
- Checking website content is accurate, professional and error-free.
- Improving product pages so they perform well in search engines such as Google.
- Managing digital advertising campaigns across Google and social media platforms including Facebook and Instagram.
- Tracking website traffic, sales performance and marketing results.
- Producing reports and sharing recommendations on how we can improve online sales.
- Working with internal teams and external developers to resolve any website issues.
- Supporting email marketing and promotional activities.
- Keeping up to date with the latest ecommerce and digital marketing trends.

What are we looking for?

We're looking for someone who is comfortable managing a website and enjoys using data and digital marketing to improve results.

You'll ideally have:
- Experience managing a Shopify website.
- Experience updating products, content and promotions within an ecommerce platform.
- Knowledge of Google Ads and social media advertising.
- An understanding of SEO (helping websites rank higher on Google).
- Experience using Google Analytics or similar reporting tools.
- Strong attention to detail.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks.
- Confidence working independently and taking ownership of your workload.
- Strong written communication skills.
- A commercial mindset and interest in growing online sales.
- Experience with email marketing platforms.
- Basic image editing skills using Canva, Photoshop or similar software.

So who are Altro?

A leading European manufacturer and supplier of premium flooring and wall cladding systems for Healthcare, construction and transport. We have been going strong since 1919. Family owned and run, we share family values; we care about you, each other and what we do.

Everyone is welcome at Altro for who they are, no matter what their background is or how they identify. We appreciate that everyone is different and with that diverse uniqueness we can all thrive. We don t want you to just work here. We want you to belong here.

If you have the relevant experience and you re ready for a new challenge, click apply today! We can't wait to hear from you.

title: Internal Communications Manager
description:
Internal and Leadership Communications Manager

Hybrid St Albans

Shape how more than 20,000 Costa team members connect with our strategy, leaders and culture. You'll drive high-impact communications that build clarity, confidence and connection across our global business, partnering closely with senior leaders to bring Costa's priorities to life.

At Costa Coffee, we are what we craft. As part of The Coca-Cola System, we're bringing great coffee experiences to customers in over 50 countries across stores, machines, and on the go.

So, why Costa Coffee?

We're passionate about creating an environment where everyone can thrive. When you join Costa, you'll enjoy:
- Annual discretionary bonus
- Share Investment Plan through Coca-Cola
- Matched pension contributions up to 10%
- Private healthcare
- 50% discount in Costa-owned stores
- A range of wellbeing, financial and lifestyle benefits

We champion diversity, equity and inclusion, creating a culture where everyone can bring their authentic self to work.

What you'll do

You'll shape how Costa Coffee's team members understand where we're heading, why it matters and the part they play in our success. You'll combine strategic thinking with hands-on delivery, turning Costa's priorities into a clear and compelling team member narrative. You'll:
- Own and deliver our internal and leadership communications strategy, annual plan and communications drumbeat, translating business priorities into a rhythm of campaigns, leadership moments and communication activity
- Shape executive and leadership communications across company-wide meetings, events and key strategic moments
- Lead communications planning and delivery for major business change and transformation initiatives, including complex or sensitive communications moments.
- Act as the communications lead for major business priorities, organisational change and strategic programmes
- Partner with senior and executive leaders, advising on communications strategy and stakeholder engagement, while working collaboratively across communications and business teams
- Set the measurement approach for internal communications, using insight to demonstrate impact and continuously improve

Who you are

You'll be an experienced communications leader who can move confidently between strategy, senior counsel and high-quality delivery. You'll bring:
- Extensive internal and leadership communications experience within a large, complex or global organisation
- A strong track record of translating business priorities into compelling narratives, supported by excellent writing, storytelling and stakeholder management skills
- Credibility and confidence advising, influencing and constructively challenging executive and senior leaders
- Proven leadership of high-profile campaigns, leadership events and multi-channel communications from strategy through to measurement
- Excellent judgement, with experience managing complex, sensitive and fast-moving communications
- Significant experience leading communications for change, transformation or organisational evolution
- Experience in retail, hospitality or FMCG would be useful, but isn't essential.

Where you'll work:

Our Support Centre teams work flexibly, combining home working with in-person collaboration. From January 2027, we'll be based in our new St Albans office, with teams coming together three days a week.

A rare opportunity to shape how one of the world's most recognised coffee brands communicates with its people, partnering with senior leaders to influence culture, engagement and business performance across a global organisation.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive

Location: Watford Salary: £30,000 - £35,000 Permanent: Office-based Monday - Friday

CTR Select is recruiting on behalf of our client for a Marketing Executive to join their team. This is a varied, commercially focused role covering digital marketing, content creation, customer engagement and sales support.

A key focus will be increasing customer adoption and use of the company's B2 B digital ordering portal, alongside delivering campaigns that support sales growth and customer engagement.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop campaigns to increase customer adoption and usage of the digital ordering portal.
- Create targeted email and SMS campaigns to drive engagement and ordering frequency.
- Produce user guides, video tutorials, sales tools, pitch decks and product materials.
- Promote new digital services and portal features to existing customers.
- Create marketing materials for sales meetings, conferences and promotions.
- Manage social media content, blogs, newsletters and website updates.
- Build and distribute targeted email campaigns.
- Monitor website performance and support SEO activity.
- Track digital engagement, sales activity and campaign performance.
- Monitor competitor activity and identify marketing opportunities.
- Work closely with sales and commercial teams to support business growth.
- Maintain brand assets, templates and marketing materials.

About You

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience in a marketing role, preferably within a B2 B or commercial environment.
- Experience with email marketing, CMS and CRM systems such as Salesforce.
- Experience using Canva, Adobe Creative Suite or similar design tools.
- Good understanding of digital marketing, social media and SEO.
- Strong Excel, organisational and analytical skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- A proactive, commercially aware and flexible approach.
- An understanding of AI tools and their application within marketing.

This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on, creative and commercially minded marketer looking for a varied role where they can make a real impact on customer engagement and business growth.

If this Marketing Executive role is of interest to you, please click apply or contact Marie Spratley in our Egham office.

title: Marketing Executive
company: The Hospice of St Francis - Agency - Permanent
description:
We are looking for a creative, organised and hands-on Marketing Executive to join our Fundraising and Marketing team. Working across the whole Hospice, you will help deliver engaging campaigns and communications that raise awareness of our services, inspire support and strengthen our connection with local communities.

This is a varied delivery and coordination role. You will create content for our website, newsletters, email, organic social media and printed materials; help coordinate campaigns and events; gather stories, photography and video sensitively; and keep activity moving against agreed briefs, priorities and deadlines. You will also support routine website updates, social media scheduling, media activity, and digital campaigns.

You will bring practical experience in marketing, communications, content, or digital marketing, together with strong copywriting and proofreading skills. You will be confident in adapting your tone for different audiences, managing several deadlines, and working collaboratively with colleagues, volunteers, supporters, and suppliers. An understanding of consent, confidentiality, accessibility, and the sensitive use of personal stories and images is important.

The role is primarily Hospice-based, with hybrid working by agreement. Travel to Hospice sites, shops, events and community activities will be required, along with occasional flexibility outside normal hours for major campaigns, events or urgent communications.

If you are a practical marketer who combines creativity with excellent organisation and attention to detail, we would love to hear from you.

title: Senior Brand Manager Mr Kipling
description:
Mr Kipling is an iconic £220m RSV brand with ambitious plans for growth, built around a simple belief: bringing a little joy and putting the cherry on top of everyday life.

We are looking for a commercially sharp and ambitious Senior Brand Manager to help shape what comes next. This is a high-impact brand leadership opportunity where you will own significant areas of the portfolio, turn consumer and category insight into winning choices, and mobilise teams across the business to deliver them brilliantly.

This is not a role for someone who simply manages a plan. It is for someone who sees opportunities, creates momentum and makes things happen, from upstream innovation and brand strategy through to standout execution with UK retailers.

What you'll be doing?
- Own key areas of the Mr Kipling portfolio and deliver against commercial objectives.
- Turn consumer, shopper and market insights into winning growth plans.
- Lead innovation projects from concept through to launch and post-launch optimisation.
- Develop compelling brand activations across digital, social and retail channels.
- Partner with Sales, Category and Commercial teams to drive customer success.
- Coach and develop our Marketing Graduate whilst leading cross-functional project teams

What we need from you?
- FMCG brand marketing experience, ideally at Brand Manager or Senior Brand Manager level.
- Strong commercial acumen with experience managing budgets and delivering results.
- A passion for consumer insight, innovation and building brands people love.
- Excellent influencing and stakeholder management skills.
- A proactive, ownership-driven mindset with the ability to turn strategy into action.

What we offer you in return:
- Competitive salary and bonus
- Car allowance
- Up to 7.5% pension
- Private medical insurance and life assurance
- Hybrid working (50% home / 50% office or site)
- Sharesave scheme and the option to purchase additional holiday
- Extensive learning and development opportunities
- Access to a wide employee discount scheme

title: Social Media Graduate Assistant
description:
Social Media Graduate Assistant
- Start date: As soon as possible
- Hours of Work: Full-time / term-time only / fixed-term until July 2027
- Salary: £21,000 per annum (term-time only)

This is an exciting opportunity for a recent graduate looking to gain hands-on experience creating engaging content, growing online communities, and helping to tell the stories that make Berkhamsted such a vibrant and inspiring place to learn and work.

Working with our Social Media Officer across our Senior Schools and Sixth Form, you will create compelling social-first content that showcases student achievements, academic excellence, co-curricular opportunities and the everyday life of our schools. From capturing photography and video content around campus to supporting campaign planning and analysing performance data, you will play a key role in enhancing the school's digital presence and reputation.

Early applications are encouraged, and interviews may take place on a rolling basis. We reserve the right to extend or close the deadline.

Application closing date: 25/10/2026

Social Media Graduate Assistant
